items.rationale: Drilling is glazing work (1.3) and the glazing peril 2.1(e) is not shown as agreed; 2.6.4 excludes glass under accidental damage, so 3.5 and 7.1.11 exclude it.

items.description: Installation of new glass into frame
items.rationale: Fitting of a glazing element is glazing work, not covered because the optional glazing peril is not agreed (3.5(b)).
The glass breakage is excluded under accidental damage (2.6.4) and the optional glazing peril is not agreed, so t=0.

items.description: Repair of dented and gouged solid-wood door frame
items.rationale: The timber frame is a non-glazing part damaged by the impact and is covered as sudden accidental damage (4.2.2, 7.1.1(b)). Repair is priced at a fair flat rate; the deductible is unknown.

items.description: Repair and refinish of scratched and chipped wooden shelf
items.rationale: The shelf was hit and damaged by the event, so repair and refinish are covered under 7.1.1(b) at a moderate flat rate.
One attendance is payable under 7.1.12 because indemnified timber repair was done at the visit, and it is not apportioned. Vehicle costs are a modest charge.
